messages:
andrea-partnerops: Heads up — CloudWorx confirmed they want ap-southeast-3 go-live target 2026-04-20. They asked for initial capacity of 24x A100-equivalent GPUs, marketplace entitlement + KMS integration. Need quota + legal signoff by EOD Friday.

liam-cloud-partner: Thanks. I've opened marketplace intake ticket PW-4521 and attached their manifest. Provider region code: ap-southeast-3. They want a dedicated pool with burst to shared for first 2 months.

sophia-legal: Can we get a simple MSA addendum for marketplace distribution + co-branded announcement clause? I can draft, but need partner legal contact.

mike-ops: Capacity check: we currently have 18x A100 committed in ap-southeast-3 across Dedicated pools. Need +6 to meet CloudWorx. Options: reassign from staging, or request burst quota from provider. I'll start the quota escalation.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: PW-4521 (CloudWorx ap-southeast-3 entitlement). ETA for vendor approval: 72h.

andrea-partnerops: Action items: 1) @liam-cloud-partner — push marketplace entitlement + KMS flow PR with CloudWorx KMS ARN. 2) @mike-ops — submit quota increase request to provider + open reserve requisition. 3) @sophia-legal — draft addendum. 4) @maya-marketing — hold on announcement draft until legal signs off.

liam-cloud-partner: Dropping minimal payload for marketplace dev: 
```json
{
  "partner": "CloudWorx",
  "region": "ap-southeast-3",
  "sku": "a100-80g",
  "units": 24,
  "kms": "arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-3:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"
}
```

sophia-legal: I created a draft addendum (placeholder NDA clause + distro rights) and uploaded to /legal/marketplace/cloudworx/apse3-draft.docx. Will iterate with partner counsel once we have their contact.

mike-ops: Raised cloud quota request: CP-9982. Also adding runbook: failover to eu-southwest if ap-southeast-3 capacity stalls. Running capacity plan and will update by EOD tomorrow.

andrea-partnerops: Also need partner engineering to confirm acceptance tests and SLOs. @sam-partner-eng can you confirm test plan?

sam-partner-eng: We will run synthetic load: 1,000 concurrent small requests + 50 long chat sessions. Acceptance criteria: latency <200ms p95 for short tokens, memory/kv cache warm within 30s, and model image compatibility. We'll provide test harness by Mon.

andrea-partnerops: Great. Scheduling a sync Wed 09:00 PDT to walk readiness checklist. If approvals come earlier we may move sooner. :calendar:

maya-marketing: Draft comms in Notion: https://redwood.notion/s/cloudworx-apse3-launch — holding until legal clears addendum. Please add any customer quotes or joint talking points there.

liam-cloud-partner: :thumbsup: I'll attach KMS proof-of-possession and the marketplace manifest to PW-4521 and ping partner legal for contact info.

deploy-bot: FYI — default canary rollout policy set to 10% unless partner requests otherwise. See /ops/runbooks/canary.md for details.

andrea-partnerops: Thanks all — I'll follow up in the morning with an updated action tracker and next steps.
